presentation: Fever, headache and body aches for 3 days
reference_text: WHO SEARO dengue guidelines (2009/2011): dengue fever + warning signs (abdominal pain, persistent vomiting, mucosal bleed, lethargy, liver enlargement, rising haematocrit); no PNPK exists on JDIH — SK KLB 406/2004 only. 3 phases: febrile, critical (24-48h), recovery. Tourniquet test, NS1, IgM/IgG, platelets, haematocrit.

presentation: Sustained fever and abdominal discomfort for 5 days
reference_text: Pedoman Pengendalian Demam Tifoid Kemenkes (KMK 364/2006); WHO typhoid guidelines. Step-ladder fever, coated tongue, rose spots, hepatosplenomegaly, relative bradycardia; complications: intestinal perforation/bleeding; blood culture gold standard, Widal low specificity; ceftriaxone/azithromycin.

presentation: Watery diarrhoea and vomiting in a toddler
reference_text: WHO diarrhoea treatment guidelines (ORT, zinc); no PNPK on JDIH. Dehydration assessment: WHO scale (some/severe), ORS + zinc 10-20mg 10-14 days, danger signs (lethargy, sunken eyes, reduced skin turgor, dry mucous membranes, decreased urine); feeding must continue.

No PNPK on JDIH — standard guidance: simple vs complex febrile seizure (age 6mo-5y, generalised <15 min, single in 24h, no focality), risk factors for recurrence, red flags for meningitis (neck stiffness, petechiae, prolonged seizure, focal), first aid, no routine EEG/neuroimaging for simple febrile seizure.

presentation: Sudden weakness of the right side of the body
target_condition: Acute ischaemic stroke in thrombolysis window
reference_text: PNPK Stroke (KMK 304/2026) — https://jdih.kemkes.go.id/documents/keputusan-menteri-kesehatan-nomor-hk0107menkes3042026 ; AHA/ASA 2019. FAST, NIHSS, non-contrast CT head within 20 min of arrival, IV thrombolysis window 4.5h (contraindications: recent surgery/bleeding, INR>1.7, BP>185/110), door-to-needle 60 min, dysphagia screen before oral intake.

presentation: Severe headache and blurred vision with very high blood pressure
reference_text: PNPK Hipertensi Dewasa (KMK 4634/2021) — https://jdih.kemkes.go.id/documents/keputusan-menteri-kesehatan-nomor-hk0107menkes46342021 ; JNC 8 / ESC 2018. Hypertensive emergency = BP>180/120 with acute end-organ damage (encephalopathy, ICH, ACS, pulmonary oedema, aortic dissection, AKI, retinopathy); IV agents (nicardipine, labetalol, nitroprusside), MAP reduction max 25% in first hour; do NOT lower too fast except aortic dissection.

presentation: High fever, muscle pain and jaundice after flooding
reference_text: No PNPK on JDIH — WHO leptospirosis guidance + Indonesian outbreak reports. Weil's disease triad: fever, jaundice, renal failure; exposure history (flood water, rats, farming), conjunctival suffusion, calf tenderness; complications: pulmonary haemorrhage, AKI, myocarditis; doxycycline/ceftriaxone, penicillin.

presentation: High fever, severe headache and neck stiffness
reference_text: No PNPK on JDIH — WHO meningitis guidance. Classic triad: fever, neck stiffness, altered consciousness; Kernig/Brudzinski signs, photophobia, petechiae/purpura (meningococcal), bulging fontanelle in infants; LP before antibiotics unless contraindication (then empiric antibiotics first); empiric ceftriaxone + vancomycin, dexamethasone adjunct.

presentation: Head injury with loss of consciousness
reference_text: PNPK Cedera Otak Traumatik (KMK 1600/2022) — https://jdih.kemkes.go.id/documents/keputusan-menteri-kesehatan-nomor-hk0107menkes16002022 . Mechanism + time, loss of consciousness duration, amnesia, vomiting, seizures, anticoagulants, alcohol; GCS, pupils, focal deficits, Cushing triad, CSF leak (rhinorrhoea/otorrhoea), racoon eyes/Battle sign; CT head criteria, neurosurgery referral.

presentation: Short stature and poor growth in a 3-year-old
reference_text: PNPK Stunting (KMK 1928/2022) — https://jdih.kemkes.go.id/documents/keputusan-menteri-kesehatan-nomor-hk0107menkes19282022 . Definition: height-for-age < -2 SD (WHO growth standards); maternal interview (antenatal care, birth weight, exclusive breastfeeding 0-6mo, complementary feeding, recurrent infections, WASH, socio-economic, food security); growth chart serial measurements; prevention: 1000 HPK (first 1000 days of life).
